predecessors: PR #1138 F-KT-owned opt-in lifecycle continuation and receipt persistence
scope: Read-only fail-closed check that a postevent active-crop derived calendar checkpoint and persisted F-WOF38 physical crop event receipt agree with exact time on a committed F-KT state.
guards: reject unready kernel, missing receipt/lifecycle or invalid persistence
reject exact time mismatch between committed physical time, derived calendar checkpoint and persisted event receipt t1
reject source-calendar selection mismatch, inactive calendar and fallow
reject receipt absent/mismatched against the actual committed F-WOF38 owner
never mutate F-KT, crop owner, calendar, accepted-window or hydraulic/transport state
limits: This only checks a postevent active-crop pair, not durable serialization or full whole-system restart
Does not establish physical sow/emergence/root initialization, harvest/reset or following crop
Does not prove hydraulic/thermal forcing provenance, mass coupling to MICRO, or SWINCO=3 physical initialization
Does not prove bit-exact equality of all owner biomass fields to a separately provided persistence view; current physical receipt and owner validity are checked
No calendar publication or physical mutation occurs
